text: Documented REST v3 API that uses standard verbs and HTTP response codes and covers AP, AR, and Spend & Expense
quote: The BILL v3 API follows the REST architecture. We use all the standard REST verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) and provide HTTP response codes.

text: Subscribe to BILL events and receive real-time webhook notifications when they trigger
quote: When you set up a subscription for your choice of BILL events, you receive real time event notifications when those events are triggered.

text: Webhook notifications are signed with HMAC-SHA256 in a signature header, so receivers can verify they came from BILL
quote: The generated hash is sent as the x-bill-sha-signature header value with all event notifications. With this value, you can verify that each notification sent to you is from BILL.

text: Up to 10 webhook subscriptions per organization
quote: You can create up to 10 webhook subscriptions per organization.

text: Payment status change events (payment.updated) are delivered as notifications
quote: You get payment.updated notifications when the status changes

text: Set up S&E budgets, users, and virtual cards through card and expense management API services
quote: Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.

text: Manage spend transactions and reimbursements through the API
quote: Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.

text: AI-powered spend management keeps card transactions controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant
quote: smart, flexible cards paired with AI-powered spend management—so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant.

text: Invoice Coding Agent performs automatic AI multi-line bill coding
quote: Automatic AI multi-line bill coding with the Invoice Coding Agent

text: Automatically scans your vendor list for BILL Network matches and connects matched vendors
quote: BILL automatically scans your vendor list to look for matches in the BILL Network. Matched vendors are connected for faster, secure payments.

text: BILL Network of 7M+ entities enables fast ePayments, simpler vendor onboarding, and automatic payment reconciliation
quote: With over 7 million entities in the BILL Network, send fast, secure ePayments, simplify vendor onboarding, and automatically reconcile payments.

text: Pay connected vendors by ACH, virtual card, or check
quote: Connect seamlessly with over 7 million vendors in the BILL Network. BILL automatically enables payments to connected vendors with ACH, virtual card, or check.

text: BILL prints and mails paper checks on your behalf
quote: Paper check is a BILL disbursement method. BILL prints and mails checks on your behalf.

text: Checks are written from a BILL account, which keeps your own bank details private
quote: Checks are written with a BILL account. This keeps your bank details private.

text: AP payments can be funded from a US bank account, credit card, or debit card
quote: BILL supports multiple AP payment funding methods: US-based bank account, credit card, and debit card.

text: Auto-pay a vendor automatically whenever a bill is created for them
quote: When this feature is enabled for a vendor, BILL automatically pays the vendor when a bill is created for the vendor.

text: Making a vendor payment without a bill auto-generates a bill at payment time
quote: If you make a vendor payment without creating a bill, a new bill is auto-generated at the time of payment.

text: Create bills one at a time or in bulk via the API
quote: Use POST /v3/bills to create a bill. You can also use POST /v3/bills/bulk to create multiple bills with one request.

text: Recurring bill templates generate identical bills for periodic vendor payments
quote: A recurring bill is a template for creating identical bills for periodic payments to a vendor.

text: Bulk payment endpoint pays up to 50 bills in a single API request
quote: Use POST /v3/payments/bulk to pay up to 50 bills with one API request.

text: Mass payment endpoint pays up to 2000 bills per request, processed asynchronously
quote: Use POST /v3/payments/mass to pay up to 2000 bills with one API request. BILL processes each payment in the mass payment request asynchronously.

text: International vendors receive payments in their local currency
quote: When you pay international vendors, the vendors receive funds in their international currency. For example, an international vendor in France receives funds in EUR.

text: Payment API responses include a unified singleStatus field
quote: the API response includes a singleStatus field for providing a unified payment status.

text: Bill approval policies control which bills need approval, by whom, and when
quote: A bill approval policy is a set of rules that enables you to control which bills require approval, by whom, and when.

text: Create purchase requests, send purchase orders, set tolerance rules, and do 2-way matching
quote:
Easily create purchase requests

Create and send purchase orders

Set tolerance rules

2-way matching

text: Sync purchase orders with automatic 2- and 3-way matching
quote: Sync purchasing orders and automatic 2 and 3-way matching

text: Automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, and others
quote: Automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, & more

text: Integrate manually with accounting software through CSV import and export
quote: **Manually integrate** with accounting software via CSV file import/export

text: Export records for vendors, customers, bills, invoices, and AP/AR payments
quote: You can export records for entities, such as vendors, customers, bills, and invoices. In addition, you can export records for transactions, such as AP payments and AR payments.

text: Audit trail API reports changes made to a vendor object
quote: Use GET /v3/reports/audit-trail/vendor/{vendorId} to get audit trail details about changes made to a vendor object.

text: Create and update vendors via REST endpoints
quote: creating a vendor is a simple `POST` to `/v3/vendors`, and modifying a vendor is a `PATCH` to `/v3/vendors/{vendorId}`

text: Build your organization structure in BILL through the API
quote: Use the BILL API to build your organization structure in BILL.

text: Add an organization bank account via API or the Add funding Element, using Plaid or manual entry
quote: You can add an organization bank with the Create a bank account API endpoint or Add funding Element (automatically with Plaid or manually).

text: Organization risk verification status (review, hold, approve, decline, etc.) is exposed
quote: the status of an organization risk verification is available (REVIEW, IN_PROGRESS, HOLD, APPROVE, or DECLINE)

text: Upload supporting attachments for vendors, customers, invoices, and bills
quote: BILL enables you to upload supporting attachments for vendors, customers, and invoices. In addition, you can upload documents for bills.

text: Monthly billing invoice statement covering an organization's billing activity
quote: BILL generates a monthly billing invoice statement for all the billing activities in an organization.

text: Embeddable pre-built, low-code BILL Elements UI widgets for financial workflows such as AP
quote: BILL Elements are pre-built, fully theme-able UI widgets that can enable your business to handle complex financial workflows.

text: Elements are fully theme-able, with colors, fonts, and styles customizable to match your brand
quote: Fully theme-able: Customize colors, fonts, and styles to seamlessly match your brand.

text: Sandbox environment for testing workflows from bill creation to AP payment without moving real money
quote: BILL offers a comprehensive sandbox environment where you can test workflows, from creating bills to completing AP payments, without moving real money.

text: API reference shows sample code in multiple languages and lets you test API calls in the docs
quote: The API Reference section enables you to view sample code in your choice of language and also test API calls in the documentation.

text: Guided recipes run chained API calls using your sandbox credentials
quote: In each recipe, you enter your sandbox account credentials and learn how the output of an API endpoint forms the input of another endpoint.

text: Postman collection available to fork for testing v3 API workflows
quote: Simply fork the collection from the Postman API Network and begin testing with different BILL v3 API workflows.

text: Docs MCP server lets AI code editors and Claude Desktop query the BILL API documentation
quote: The BILL API documentation MCP server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, plus general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the BILL API documentation.

text: llms.txt docs index, plus markdown versions of every docs page for AI agents
quote: For AI agents: the docs index is at https://developer.bill.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

text: Single Sign-On and dual control security features
quote:
Single Sign-On

Dual control
